**What happened, and what you expected instead**



**The report**

Drag the file Winbar just showed you in the Finder into this box. It's plain text, so you can read
it first. Unless you unticked the box in Report a Problem…, the names in it are placeholders such as
`<mac>`, `<user>` and `<vm-1>`. It never contains your Windows password.
